evals.prompt: We are building an AI devtools startup called 'Vortex'. Create a full brand visual identity strategy and core metaphor.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive VI design strategy including brand soul (mission, vision, values), core metaphor, style quadrant positioning, foundation layer specs, and developer touchpoint applications.
expectations: Defines Mission, Vision, and Values answering the three fundamental brand questions
Establishes a core creative concept or metaphor ('Polaris')
Defines style quadrant positioning (e.g. Modern vs Classic, Human vs Tech)
Outlines Foundation Layer (Logo clear space, Color strategy, Typography hierarchy, Grid system)
Includes digital touchpoints (hero website, IDE plugin badge, dev docs)

evals.prompt: 做一个国风轻养生茶饮品牌'草木知'的 VI 视觉系统全案设计。
evals.expected_output: A complete Brand VI strategy for a modern herbal tea brand, integrating cultural aesthetics, color psychology, and physical touchpoints.
expectations: 明确品牌灵魂三问与核心受众画像（情绪与生活方式）
提炼东方美学核心隐喻与视觉调性（如草木灵气、极简留白）
规划多触点应用规范（茶饮杯包装、门店招牌、线上小程序、周边物料）
提供基础层规范框架（品牌标准字、东方矿物色彩系统与WCAG对比度校验）
包含品牌交付手册与防错规范（禁止拉伸、错误色彩搭配等）
